summary: Of Guardia Lombardi, husband of Claudia Di Vivo and an ancestor of Maria d'Ambrosio; not an ancestor of John.
bio: Claudio Gialanella was born in 1717 at Guardia Lombardi, Avellino, in Campania, and died there in 1811. His wife was Claudia Di Vivo (1722-1811). He was an ancestor of Maria d'Ambrosio and so belongs to the family by marriage rather than by descent: he was not one of John's own ancestors.
